accentColorNote: Sampled from the badge's own SVG source, which specifies no fill colour on any path and therefore renders in the SVG default of solid black. This is the corporate wordmark logo, not the red 'S' emblem SEAT uses on some cars and marketing; no colour specification for either mark was found, so the mark actually on file is what is recorded rather than the widely recognised red being guessed at.
